idea: Filter What's new and Known issues by area
why: Readers usually care about one area, like email or connectors.

idea: Social preview image and repo topics
why: Links shared on X show a blank card today.
A permanent page per week is easier to share than a scrolling list.
Colors are hand-picked to pass AA; a check keeps future tweaks honest.

idea: Before and after screenshots for design PRs
why: The design log should show change, not just describe it.

idea: README badges generated from repo data
why: Live CI, last run, entry count, and design score without outside badge services.

idea: v1 layout: single column, system fonts, light and dark themes
why: Fast, readable on phones, no external fonts or scripts.
